title: Sandbox dreams
content: Before November, I used to have loads of Mall World dreams pretty much every day. Then somehow since I happen to discover the secret identity of the entity who was causing me nightmare scenarios in Mall World, I dream even less than ever before and if I dream its just me being inside a sandbox version of my real life home. It has gotten to the point that there are no AI characters that interact with me anymore. It's just basically bedrooms with nonfunctioning lights with the same furniture as in real life. And whenever I try to go out of my home in my dream, I just get sent back immediately to my bed just to wake up again and repeat the same process. It's just getting annoying at this point. I am not even allowed to have fun in the very few Mall World dreams I had since November.
